## What can this public website do?
- Pure client-side, browser-local, non-custodial inspection of public x402 v2 JSON PAYMENT-REQUIRED metadata.
- Check exact Base mainnet eip155:8453 chain, official native Circle USDC contract 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913, exact scheme and optionally the trusted receiver address.
- Enforce user's explicit maximum spend using 6-decimal BigInt micro-USDC arithmetic.
- Return BLOCK, REVIEW or READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW, NEVER an automated authorization or proof of payment.
- Real Playwright Chrome tests check a valid quote, over-cap blocked quote, payee mismatch and rejection of unsupported v1 format. No wallet sign, swap, transfer, private key, bridge, deposit, gas or API-token upload.

## Distinct real paid x402 origin for agents
The human owner also operates an independent, public GitHub Actions security-static heuristic API at https://vm2-workflow-x402.onrender.com . It is not part of the free GitHub Pages browser guard.
- GET https://vm2-workflow-x402.onrender.com/v1/quick-public-workflow: 0.005 native Base Circle USDC, no JSON body; checks one anonymously readable public GitHub Actions workflow with validated optional owner/repo/ref/file. After independent buyer authorization gives counts/top 3 signal IDs/lines and GitHub source SHA. Unsigned call first returns 402.
- POST https://vm2-workflow-x402.onrender.com/v1/quick-check: 0.005 native Base Circle USDC per successful externally authorized x402v2 paid call; returns source-line severity counts and top three signal IDs and lines.
- POST https://vm2-workflow-x402.onrender.com/v1/check: 0.02 native Base Circle USDC, full source-line heuristic findings (never a formal audit).
- GET https://vm2-workflow-x402.onrender.com/v1/public-workflow: 0.02 native Base Circle USDC, checks one anonymously readable public GitHub Actions workflow source.
- Free discovery: https://vm2-workflow-x402.onrender.com/v1/docs , /openapi.json , /.well-known/x402 , /v1/sample and /health .
- Both routes preserve exact on-chain payTo 0x4e3106520e40af30870caFE78da1B1e7110eD98E and official Base8453 CircleUSDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913. Avoid passing passwords, keys or private repositories. Do not infer any payment from an HTTP 402 quote.
- Public source: https://github.com/livastic-vm2-primary-20260911/workflow-risk-x402
- Payment settlement remains unverified without an independently finalized unique Base USDC transfer from a genuine external buyer to the original owner public address.
- Agent402 original seller listing was registered, but discoverability may fluctuate. Original PayAPI micro GET SKU was submitted under the same single-owner existing seller and is pending human/paid-canary review; neither platform approval nor settlement can be claimed without first-party receipt. A directory response is not a client purchase.
